narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Eight is one stick and four dots.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Four dots are a full group of four, the same as one plate of idlis.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A full group must always turn into the next mark up.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows a stick and four dots for eight; the four dots flash; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check a numeral, add up the values of its marks.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A stick and three dots give four and three, which is seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>No mark should ever appear four times, whatever shapes you chose.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer row; check lines appear: add up the marks; never four of one mark
